```{r}
# Install/load necessary packages
if (!require("sf")) install.packages("sf")
if (!require("dplyr")) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!require("stringr")) install.packages("stringr")
if (!require("viridis")) install.packages("viridis")
if (!require("leaflet")) install.packages("leaflet")
if (!require("leaflet.extras")) install.packages("leaflet.extras")
if (!require("leafem")) install.packages("leafem") # for minimap

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(viridis)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(leafem)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)

# 1. Load mangrove CSR data
sites <- read.csv("csr_mangrove_.csv")

# 2. Extract numeric value from quantity by removing non-numeric characters
sites$quantity_num <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", sites$quantity))

# Clean and unify Company names (institution)
sites$Company <- str_to_title(str_trim(sites$Company))

# 3. Create clickable links with 'Kantor Berita' as short link text and real URL as href
sites <- sites %>%
  mutate(
    TautanLink = ifelse(
      !is.na(Tautan) & Tautan != "",
      paste0('<a href="', Tautan, '" target="_blank">', `Kantor_Berita`, '</a>'),
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# 4. Summarize seedlings and create aggregated popup content
summary_sites <- sites %>%
  group_by(Kabupaten.Kota) %>%
  summarise(
    total_quantity = sum(quantity_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    Institution = paste(unique(na.omit(Company)), collapse = "<br/>"),
    Year = paste(unique(na.omit(Year)), collapse = ", "),
    Tautan = paste(unique(na.omit(TautanLink)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Clean district names for joining
  mutate(district_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(gsub("^Kab\\.|^Kota ", "", Kabupaten.Kota))))

# 5. Read Indonesia Kabupaten shapefile and prepare
kab_sf <- st_read("Kabupaten_BIG_PPBW_V1.shp")
kab_sf <- st_make_valid(kab_sf)
kab_sf <- kab_sf %>%
  mutate(district_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(WADMKK)))

# 6. Join summarized data with spatial data and filter for planting data
kab_joined <- kab_sf %>%
  left_join(summary_sites, by = "district_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_quantity) & total_quantity > 0)

# 7. Calculate centroids of polygons with slight jitter for map markers
kab_joined$centroid <- st_centroid(kab_joined$geometry)
coords <- st_coordinates(kab_joined$centroid)
set.seed(123) # for reproducible jitter
jitter_amount <- 0.05
coords[,1] <- coords[,1] + runif(nrow(coords), -jitter_amount, jitter_amount)
coords[,2] <- coords[,2] + runif(nrow(coords), -jitter_amount, jitter_amount)
kab_joined$lon <- coords[,1]
kab_joined$lat <- coords[,2]

# 8. Create viridis color palette for seedling quantities
pal <- colorNumeric(viridis(256), domain = kab_joined$total_quantity)

# 9. Create HTML popup labels with formatted content and clickable links
kab_joined$popup <- paste0(
  "<b>", kab_joined$Kabupaten.Kota, "</b><br/>",
  "Seedlings: ", format(kab_joined$total_quantity, big.mark = ","), "<br/><br/>",
  "<b>Institution:</b><br/>", kab_joined$Institution, "<br/><br/>",
  "<b>Year(s):</b> ", kab_joined$Year, "<br/><br/>",
  "<b>Links:</b><br/>", kab_joined$Tautan
)

# 10. Create Leaflet interactive map with persistent popups and clickable links
m <- leaflet(kab_joined) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    radius = 6,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillColor = ~pal(total_quantity),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~lapply(popup, HTML),
    popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE, autoClose = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~total_quantity,
    title = "Planted Seedlings",
    position = "bottomright",
    labFormat = labelFormat(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  addMiniMap(
    tiles = providers$OpenStreetMap,
    toggleDisplay = TRUE,
    position = "bottomleft"
  ) %>%
  addMouseCoordinates()

# 11. Print map in R viewer or R Markdown
m

# 12. Save as an interactive standalone HTML file
saveWidget(m, file = "index.html", selfcontained = T, libdir = "csr_mangrove_final_")


```

```{r}
# Install and load required packages if needed
if (!require("sf")) install.packages("sf")
if (!require("dplyr")) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!require("maps")) install.packages("maps")
if (!require("stringr")) install.packages("stringr")
if (!require("viridis")) install.packages("viridis")
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(maps)
library(stringr)
library(viridis)

# 1. Load CSR mangrove data from uploaded file
sites <- read.csv("csr_mangrove_.csv")
sites$quantity_num <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", sites$quantity))

# 2. Summarize seedlings by Kabupaten/Kota
summary_sites <- sites %>%
  group_by(Kabupaten.Kota) %>%
  summarise(
    total_quantity = sum(quantity_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(district_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(gsub("^Kab\\.|^Kota ", "", Kabupaten.Kota))))

# 3. Read shapefile for Indonesia Kabupaten
kab_sf <- st_read("Kabupaten_BIG_PPBW_V1.shp")
kab_sf <- st_make_valid(kab_sf)
kab_sf <- kab_sf %>%
  mutate(district_clean = str_to_lower(str_trim(WADMKK)))

# 4. Join summarized data with spatial data and filter for relevant plantings
kab_joined <- kab_sf %>%
  left_join(summary_sites, by = "district_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_quantity) & total_quantity > 0)

# 5. Calculate centroids and apply slight jitter for visualization clarity
kab_joined$centroid <- st_centroid(kab_joined$geometry)
coords <- st_coordinates(kab_joined$centroid)
set.seed(123)
jitter_amount <- 0.05
coords[,1] <- coords[,1] + runif(nrow(coords), -jitter_amount, jitter_amount)
coords[,2] <- coords[,2] + runif(nrow(coords), -jitter_amount, jitter_amount)

# 6. Map color scale based on total seedling quantity
total_qty <- kab_joined$total_quantity
point_colors <- viridis(length(total_qty))[rank(total_qty)]

# 7. Plotting map
min_lon <- 90; max_lon <- 150
min_lat <- -15; max_lat <- 15
point_cex <- 1.1

pdf("CSR_map_adjusted.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)
old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
plot(NA, xlim = c(min_lon, max_lon), ylim = c(min_lat, max_lat),
     type = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
rect(min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat, col = "lightblue", border = NA)
map("world", xlim = c(min_lon, max_lon), ylim = c(min_lat, max_lat),
    col = "grey85", fill = TRUE, add = TRUE)
abline(v = seq(min_lon, max_lon, 4), col = "grey70", lty = 3)
abline(h = seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4), col = "grey70", lty = 3)
axis(1, at = seq(min_lon, max_lon, 4), labels = paste0(seq(min_lon, max_lon, 4), "°E"), cex.axis = 0.7)
axis(2, at = seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4), labels = paste0(abs(seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4)), 
     ifelse(seq(min_lat, max_lat, 4) < 0, "°S", "°N")), cex.axis = 0.7)

# Plot the CSR seedling planting locations
points(coords[,1], coords[,2], pch = 21, bg = point_colors, col = "black", cex = point_cex)

# Add color scale legend
colorbar_x <- max_lon - 10
colorbar_y_bottom <- min_lat + 2
colorbar_y_top <- colorbar_y_bottom + 8

# Background for legend
rect(colorbar_x - 0.2, colorbar_y_bottom - 0.2, colorbar_x + 3.5, colorbar_y_top + 1, col = "white", border = NA)

# Legend color gradient
legend_image <- as.raster(matrix(rev(viridis(100)), ncol = 1))
rasterImage(legend_image, colorbar_x, colorbar_y_bottom, colorbar_x + 1, colorbar_y_top)

# Add labels for legend
text(colorbar_x + 2, seq(colorbar_y_bottom, colorbar_y_top, length.out = 5),
     labels = round(seq(min(total_qty), max(total_qty), length.out = 5)), cex = 0.7, adj = 0)
text(colorbar_x + 0.5, colorbar_y_top + 0.8, "Seedling Quantity", cex = 0.8)

# Scale bar and North arrow
scalebar_length <- 200 # in km
scalebar_x <- min_lon + 1
scalebar_y <- min_lat + 1
rect(scalebar_x, scalebar_y, scalebar_x + 2, scalebar_y + 0.2, col = "black")
text(scalebar_x + 1, scalebar_y - 0.4, paste0(scalebar_length, " km"), cex = 0.7, adj = 0.5)
north_x <- max_lon - 1.5
north_N_y <- max_lat - 1
text(north_x, north_N_y, "N", cex = 1.1, font = 2)

par(old_par)
dev.off()

```
